answer: Farms must eventually pool what they earn, so watch where value leaves. Heads whose transfers or swap payouts reach a common destination merge into one claimant, and their still-vesting balances are re-split as a single share. Since rewards vest over about 100 epochs, a farm that cashes out early exposes the whole vine of heads while most earnings are still clawable. Staying hidden means keeping N wallets apart forever, which defeats the point of farming. The public atlas of flows lets anyone replay the check; an honest agent, one lotus on one stem, never notices.
